The safety outcomes included the risk of hypoglycemia, urinary tract infection (UTI), and genital infection.

C6_ROWS_AND_POOLED.evidence: Meta-analysis for the safety outcomes. ( A ) Relative risks of hypoglycemia with SGLT2 inhibitor plus DPP4 inhibitor compared with placebo plus DPP4 inhibitor. ( C ) Relative risks of genital infection with SGLT2 inhibitor plus DPP4 inhibitor compared with placebo plus DPP4 inhibitor.
